profile.summary: The Breckenridge is an Intrepid-class Starfleet vessel: compact, advanced, fast, and built for autonomous long-range operations without Galaxy-class scale.
profile.narrationGuide: Use a close 15-deck shipboard community, compact capability, accountable operational tradeoffs, and recurring spaces instead of generic starship sprawl.
hardFacts: The bridge, ready room, and briefing room occupy Deck 1.
Sickbay is on Deck 5 and main engineering is on Deck 11.
Advanced systems create dependencies; transporters, medical automation, tactical systems, replicators, and landing capability do not erase risk or logistics.
Voyager is the class model, not imported campaign history.

playerText.label: Segmented isolation
playerText.summary: The crew can isolate one refit segment from the rest of the ship for controlled operations.

capabilities.narratorGuidance: When the player deliberately invokes isolation and an authored interaction permits it, allow a route that contains a problem inside one segment instead of exposing the full integrated ship.
limits: Isolation creates a bounded option; it does not guarantee that the operation succeeds.
It cannot substitute for full combined-load or failover validation.

playerText.label: Integrated failover
playerText.summary: Validated cross-system failover can preserve essential functions during a bounded subsystem loss.

capabilities.narratorGuidance: When an authored interaction permits it, allow validated failover to preserve one essential function through a bounded subsystem loss while retaining credible costs and uncertainty.
limits: Failover preserves an authored essential function, not the entire ship.
It does not erase damage, time pressure, or consequences already established in the scene.

playerText.label: Independent correlation
playerText.summary: Calibrated sensors can compare shipboard readings against a genuinely independent reference.

capabilities.narratorGuidance: When the player obtains an independent reference and an authored interaction permits it, allow correlation to distinguish supported inconsistencies that shipboard readings alone could not establish.
limits: Correlation requires a genuinely independent source in the scene.
It does not identify an unknown actor or prove provenance by itself.

playerText.label: Cross-system reconstruction
playerText.summary: Validated live-load calibration can reconstruct eligible signatures across independent sensor channels.

capabilities.narratorGuidance: When an authored interaction permits it and suitable observations exist, allow a bounded reconstruction assembled from independent channels rather than a single decisive scan.
limits: Reconstruction needs suitable observations and cannot conjure evidence that was never recorded.
It narrows an authored uncertainty; it is not universal deception detection.

playerText.label: Integration cascade risk
playerText.summary: Unvalidated combined-load operations can propagate one refit fault across otherwise serviceable systems.

constraints.narratorGuidance: Do not allow an unsupported full-system shortcut while this constraint is active; combined-load solutions must respect the risk of a cascading refit fault.

playerText.label: Sensor corroboration required
playerText.summary: Fine identity, provenance, and reconstruction claims need evidence independent of the provisional shipboard baseline.

constraints.narratorGuidance: Do not let Breckenridge sensor readings alone settle fine identity, provenance, or reconstructed intent while this constraint is active.

playerText.label: Systems Integration
playerText.summary: The refit restored individual systems faster than it proved they can operate together under sustained load.

playerText.label: Unvalidated
playerText.why: The refit passed component certification, but no accepted isolation, combined-load, or failover record proves the new integration layer.
playerText.mechanicalEffect: Full-system shortcuts remain unsafe because one refit fault can cascade across systems.

playerText.label: Segmented
playerText.why: An accepted controlled test proves that one refit segment can operate independently, but combined-load and failover behavior remain unvalidated.
playerText.mechanicalEffect: Authored isolation routes can contain a problem inside one segment; unsupported combined-load shortcuts remain unsafe.

playerText.label: Integrated
playerText.why: Accepted combined-load and failover validations prove that the refit layer can sustain linked operations and preserve bounded essential functions.
playerText.mechanicalEffect: Authored integrated-failover routes are available during bounded subsystem loss.

playerText.label: Complete a segment isolation test
playerText.summary: Prove that one refit segment can operate independently without propagating its fault state.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts a completed controlled isolation test and a settled result showing the segment operated independently without propagating the test fault.
exclusions: Ordering, scheduling, configuring, or beginning the isolation test is not a completed result.

playerText.label: Complete combined-load validation
playerText.summary: Run the refit systems together under a sustained representative operational load.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts completion of a sustained representative combined-load run with a settled validation result.
exclusions: A short diagnostic, proposed run, or interrupted test without a settled result is not combined-load validation.

playerText.label: Validate integrated failover
playerText.summary: Demonstrate that a bounded subsystem loss transfers one essential function without an uncontrolled cascade.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts a completed failover exercise in which one essential function transfers successfully after a bounded subsystem loss without an uncontrolled cascade.
exclusions: Failover configuration, a paper review, or an exercise that has not reached a settled result is not validation.

playerText.label: Sensor Calibration
playerText.summary: The new sensor-processing stack is functional, but its fine correlation remains provisional after refit.

playerText.label: Provisional
playerText.why: No accepted controlled comparison ties the refit sensor stack to an independent reference.
playerText.mechanicalEffect: Fine identity, provenance, and reconstruction claims require independent corroboration.

playerText.label: Aligned
playerText.why: An accepted controlled baseline comparison proves reliable correlation against an independent reference.
playerText.mechanicalEffect: Authored independent-correlation routes can expose supported inconsistencies when a genuine external reference is available.

playerText.label: Validated
playerText.why: Accepted live-load validation proves that independent sensor channels remain coherent during sustained operations.
playerText.mechanicalEffect: Authored cross-system reconstruction routes can assemble eligible signatures from independent observations.

playerText.label: Establish a controlled sensor baseline
playerText.summary: Compare the refit sensor stack against a genuinely independent reference under controlled conditions.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts completion of a controlled comparison against a genuinely independent reference and a settled alignment result.
exclusions: Internal self-test, using another Breckenridge subsystem as the only reference, or beginning the comparison is not an independent baseline.

playerText.label: Validate sensors under live load
playerText.summary: Demonstrate coherent independent-channel correlation during sustained real operations.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted prose depicts completed live-load validation using independent channels during sustained real operations with a settled result.
exclusions: A laboratory-only baseline, a proposed field trial, or one unexplained matching reading is not live-load validation.
